ticks.note: One second per tick. Tick 1 enters `Off`.
Pressed: `On` is entered, its entry action switches the `light` on, and its own clock starts at 0.
The clock of `On` is at 1000. It is declared inside `On`, so the trace does not show it.

Pressed again: the self-loop leaves `On` (the exit action switches the light off) and enters it afresh (the entry action switches it on again). Entering `On` re-initialises its clock to 0, with no reset written anywhere.
5000: `Lit` → `Expired` reaches the final state, `join to Off` fires in the same tick and the exit action switches the `light` off.
In `Off`. There is no clock running now: it belongs to `On`.
